content: French typography (AZERTY Global guide, canada.ca): NBSP U+00A0 before colon; narrow NBSP U+202F before semicolon, exclamation and question marks; NBSP inside and outside guillemets « »; curly apostrophe U+2019 in prose (straight quote reserved for code); single ellipsis character U+2026; French capitals keep their accents (É, À, Ç); headings in sentence case not Title Case; weekdays and months lowercase; decimal comma and U+202F digit grouping; NBSP between number and % or unit symbol; ordinals 1er/1re/2e. Canadian French differs for ; ! ? spacing. A single house style must be chosen and applied consistently.
